items.difficulty_reason: A faithful functor over (Sch/S)_fppf reflects/creates the fibre-product and equalizer structure: (1) is read off from the Categories fibre-product-raises lemma, and for (2) the author takes an equalizer x -> x' of a, b in X and proves f(x) -> f(x') is an equalizer in Y by pulling x' back along the scheme morphism h : V -> U' image of y -> f(x'), using the fibred-category axiom to write y = f(h^*x'), and concluding with faithfulness. Retained author proof at lines 2923-2942.
